analysis: The only change in this batch is a documentation entry in CHANGELOG.md. The patch adds an 'Unreleased — provider cache storage controls' section after line 2, and no executable source, config or schema is included. The entry describes `darkbloom cache set --daily-write-gb ... --directory ...` and `cache status`. It also describes optional external cache storage with local-APFS validation, mandatory encryption on external volumes, volume-UUID pinning, no fallback if the disk is unavailable or replaced, keys and the rolling-day write ledger kept on the Mac, and changes applying after restart. This touches the existing SSD prefix-cache surface (T-041, T-016, A-001, TB-003). The relevant mitigations are the encrypted offload tier, the persistent write-budget ledger from the 0.9.19 entry, and the 20 GiB pre-write reserve noted in the canonical context. The changelog is not evidence of the implementation: external-volume path validation, symlink and volume-swap handling, key placement and ledger integrity cannot be confirmed from it. If the implementation PR changes cache code, later passes should review the --directory validation, the UUID pinning and no-fallback logic, the encryption key and ledger locations, and any threat-model update for removable or external storage. No security regression or invalidated assumption is visible in the changelog text, so I report no findings. Coverage limit: no implementation code was supplied.
